The morning light filtered through the tall windows, casting long shadows across the quiet room. She had waited for this moment for years, and yet now that it had arrived she felt strangely calm. Outside, the city was beginning to wake, and the first buses rumbled down the wet streets. He poured two cups of coffee and set one down beside the stack of unread letters. Neither of them spoke for a while; the silence was comfortable, familiar, and unhurried.

The morning light filtered through the tall windows, casting long shadows across the quiet room. She had waited for this moment for years, and yet now that it had arrived she felt strangely calm.
